topic.source_contract: affected catchment, protected site, development wastewater, current and future land use, nutrient budget, mitigation rights, environmental permissions, delivery and long-term monitoring evidence

sources.publisher: Environment Agency, Natural England and Defra

scope_guards: A catchment map is not treated as a completed nutrient budget.
A calculator result is not treated as an approved appropriate assessment.
A mitigation proposal is not treated as secured mitigation.
Purchased credits are not treated as delivered ecological mitigation without legal and delivery evidence.
A planning condition is not treated as discharged.
A wetland design is not treated as functioning nutrient removal.
A permit application is not treated as an environmental permission.
No score or promotion is written without exact catchment, budget, legal security, permissions, delivery and monitoring evidence.
